name: DeepL
summary: AI translation and writing assistant known for accuracy.
description: DeepL provides AI translation for text and documents in dozens of languages, plus DeepL Write for editing and an API for developers. It is widely regarded for natural, accurate translations and data security for businesses. A free version allows up to 50,000 characters per month; DeepL Pro Individual costs EUR 7.49/month billed annually, with a 30-day free trial, and Team and Business plans are available.
